title_en: Reporting offers, suggestions, orders, intentions, etc.
title_vi: Tường thuật lời đề nghị, gợi ý, mệnh lệnh, ý định v.v.
theory_html:
A. Verb + (object) + to-infinitive clause

A. Động từ + (tân ngữ) + mệnh đề to-V

When we report offers, suggestions, orders, intentions, promises, requests, etc. we can follow some verbs in the reporting clause with a to-infinitive clause:

Khi tường thuật lời đề nghị, gợi ý, mệnh lệnh, ý định, lời hứa, yêu cầu v.v., có thể dùng một số động từ tường thuật với mệnh đề to-V:

  • ‘The theatre will be built next to the town hall.’ → They propose to build the theatre next to the town hall. (not They propose them to build …)

    ‘Nhà hát sẽ được xây cạnh tòa thị chính.’ → Họ đề xuất xây nhà hát cạnh tòa thị chính.

Also: agree, demand, guarantee, offer, promise, swear, threaten, volunteer

Tương tự: agree, demand, guarantee, offer, promise, swear, threaten, volunteer

an object + to-infinitive clause:

tân ngữ + mệnh đề to-V:

  • ‘You should take the job, Fran.’ → She encouraged Fran to take the job.

    ‘Fran à, bạn nên nhận công việc đó.’ → Cô ấy khuyến khích Fran nhận công việc.

Also: advise, ask, call on, command, instruct, invite, order, persuade, recommend, remind, request, urge, warn, tell

Tương tự: advise, ask, call on, command, instruct, invite, order, persuade, recommend, remind, request, urge, warn, tell

The object usually refers to the person who the offer, suggestion, etc. is made to; that is, the person who performs the action in the reported clause. Compare the use of ask with and without an object before a to-infinitive clause:

Tân ngữ thường chỉ người nhận lời đề nghị, gợi ý v.v., tức người thực hiện hành động trong mệnh đề được tường thuật. So sánh ask có và không có tân ngữ trước mệnh đề to-V:

  • We asked to leave our bags outside the exam room. (= this is something we wanted)

    Chúng tôi xin để túi bên ngoài phòng thi. (= điều chúng tôi muốn)

  • They asked us to leave our bags outside the exam room. (= this is something they wanted)

    Họ yêu cầu chúng tôi để túi bên ngoài phòng thi. (= điều họ muốn)

B. Verb + that-clause or verb + to-infinitive clause

B. Động từ + mệnh đề that hoặc + mệnh đề to-V

After some verbs we can use a that-clause instead of a to-infinitive clause:

Sau một số động từ, có thể dùng mệnh đề that thay cho mệnh đề to-V:

  • He promised to arrive on time. / He promised that he would arrive on time.

    Anh ấy hứa sẽ đến đúng giờ.

Also: agree, demand, expect, guarantee, hope, propose, request, vow

Tương tự: agree, demand, expect, guarantee, hope, propose, request, vow

With a that-clause the person promising, etc. and the person referred to in the reported clause may be different:

Với mệnh đề that, người hứa v.v. và người được nhắc đến trong mệnh đề được tường thuật có thể khác nhau:

  • He promised that he wouldn’t be late. (‘He …’ and ‘… he …’ may refer to different people)

    Anh ấy hứa rằng anh ấy (có thể là người khác) sẽ không đến muộn.

C. that-clause only: insist, order, say, suggest

C. Chỉ dùng mệnh đề that: insist, order, say, suggest

After the verbs insist, order, say and suggest we use a that-clause but not a to-infinitive clause:

Sau insist, order, say, suggest dùng mệnh đề that chứ không dùng mệnh đề to-V:

  • There were cheers when he suggested that we went home early. (not … suggested to go …)

    Mọi người reo hò khi anh ấy gợi ý chúng tôi về sớm.

Advise and order can be used with an object + to-infinitive clause or a that-clause:

Advise và order có thể dùng với tân ngữ + mệnh đề to-V hoặc mệnh đề that:

  • I advised that she should accept. (or I advised her to accept.; but not I advised to accept …)

    Tôi khuyên cô ấy nên nhận lời.

D. to-infinitive clause only

D. Chỉ dùng mệnh đề to-V

After some verbs we use a to-infinitive clause but not a that-clause:

Sau một số động từ dùng mệnh đề to-V chứ không dùng mệnh đề that:

  • Carolyn intends to return to Dublin after a year in Canada. (not Carolyn intends that she should return …)

    Carolyn định trở về Dublin sau một năm ở Canada.

Also: long, offer, refuse, volunteer, want

Tương tự: long, offer, refuse, volunteer, want

E. advise / propose / recommend / suggest + -ing

When we report a suggestion, either what the person reported might do themselves, or what someone else might do, we can use a reporting clause with advise, propose, recommend or suggest followed by an -ing clause rather than a that-clause:

Khi tường thuật một gợi ý – điều người nói hoặc người khác có thể làm – có thể dùng advise, propose, recommend, suggest + mệnh đề -ing thay cho mệnh đề that:

  • The lecturer recommended reading a number of books before the exam. (or … recommended that the students should read a number of books before the exam.)

    Giảng viên khuyên nên đọc một số sách trước kỳ thi.

mcq.question: ‘The theatre will be built next to the town hall.’ → They propose ___ the theatre next to the town hall.
mcq.full: ‘The theatre will be built next to the town hall.’ → They propose to build the theatre next to the town hall.
mcq.vi: ‘Nhà hát sẽ được xây cạnh tòa thị chính.’ → Họ đề xuất xây nhà hát cạnh tòa thị chính.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: propose + to-V (không có tân ngữ).
mcq.key: ‘The theatre will be built next to the town hall.’ → They propose ___ the theatre next to the town hall.|to build

mcq.question: ‘You should take the job, Fran.’ → She encouraged ___ the job.
mcq.full: ‘You should take the job, Fran.’ → She encouraged Fran to take the job.
mcq.vi: ‘Fran à, bạn nên nhận công việc đó.’ → Cô ấy khuyến khích Fran nhận công việc.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: encourage + O + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘You should take the job, Fran.’ → She encouraged ___ the job.|Fran to take

mcq.question: We asked ___ our bags outside the exam room. (= this is something we wanted)
mcq.full: We asked to leave our bags outside the exam room. (= this is something we wanted)
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi xin để túi bên ngoài phòng thi.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + to-V = điều mình muốn.
mcq.key: We asked ___ our bags outside the exam room. (= this is something we wanted)|to leave

mcq.question: They asked ___ our bags outside the exam room. (= this is something they wanted)
mcq.full: They asked us to leave our bags outside the exam room. (= this is something they wanted)
mcq.vi: Họ yêu cầu chúng tôi để túi bên ngoài phòng thi.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + O + to-V = điều họ muốn.
mcq.key: They asked ___ our bags outside the exam room. (= this is something they wanted)|us to leave

mcq.question: ‘If I were you, I’d read the exam questions very carefully.’ → He advised ___ the exam questions very carefully.
mcq.full: ‘If I were you, I’d read the exam questions very carefully.’ → He advised us to read the exam questions very carefully.
mcq.vi: ‘Nếu là các em, thầy sẽ đọc kỹ đề thi.’ → Thầy khuyên chúng tôi đọc kỹ đề thi.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: advise + O + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘If I were you, I’d read the exam questions very carefully.’ → He advised ___ the exam questions very carefully.|us to read

mcq.question: ‘Okay, I’ll collect Declan from school.’ → He agreed ___ Declan from school.
mcq.full: ‘Okay, I’ll collect Declan from school.’ → He agreed to collect Declan from school.
mcq.vi: ‘Được rồi, tôi sẽ đón Declan ở trường.’ → Anh ấy đồng ý đón Declan ở trường.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: agree + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘Okay, I’ll collect Declan from school.’ → He agreed ___ Declan from school.|to collect

mcq.question: ‘Be quiet!’ → He ordered ___ quiet.
mcq.full: ‘Be quiet!’ → He ordered us to be quiet.
mcq.vi: ‘Im lặng!’ → Ông ấy ra lệnh cho chúng tôi im lặng.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: order + O + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘Be quiet!’ → He ordered ___ quiet.|us to be

mcq.question: ‘Please stay for a few more days.’ → He urged ___ for a few more days.
mcq.full: ‘Please stay for a few more days.’ → He urged me to stay for a few more days.
mcq.vi: ‘Ở lại thêm vài ngày nhé.’ → Anh ấy nài tôi ở lại thêm vài ngày.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: urge + O + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘Please stay for a few more days.’ → He urged ___ for a few more days.|me to stay

mcq.question: ‘I will fight the ban on smoking in public places.’ → He vowed ___ the ban on smoking in public places.
mcq.full: ‘I will fight the ban on smoking in public places.’ → He vowed to fight the ban on smoking in public places.
mcq.vi: ‘Tôi sẽ đấu tranh chống lệnh cấm hút thuốc nơi công cộng.’ → Ông ấy thề đấu tranh chống lệnh cấm hút thuốc nơi công cộng.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: vow + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘I will fight the ban on smoking in public places.’ → He vowed ___ the ban on smoking in public places.|to fight

mcq.question: ‘Can you lend me ten pounds?’ → He asked ___ him ten pounds.
mcq.full: ‘Can you lend me ten pounds?’ → He asked me to lend him ten pounds.
mcq.vi: ‘Cho tôi mượn mười bảng được không?’ → Anh ấy nhờ tôi cho anh ấy mượn mười bảng.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + O + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘Can you lend me ten pounds?’ → He asked ___ him ten pounds.|me to lend

mcq.question: ‘The government should do more to help the homeless.’ → He called ___ the government to do more to help the homeless.
mcq.full: ‘The government should do more to help the homeless.’ → He called on the government to do more to help the homeless.
mcq.vi: ‘Chính phủ nên làm nhiều hơn để giúp người vô gia cư.’ → Ông ấy kêu gọi chính phủ làm nhiều hơn để giúp người vô gia cư.
mcq.expl:
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-infinitive; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + object + to-infinitive.
agree / offer / promise / propose / threaten / volunteer / swear + to-V; advise / ask / encourage / order / persuade / remind / tell / urge / call on + tân ngữ + to-V.
Điểm ngữ pháp: call on + O + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘The government should do more to help the homeless.’ → He called ___ the government to do more to help the homeless.|on

mcq.question: He promised ___ on time.
mcq.full: He promised to arrive on time.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy hứa sẽ đến đúng giờ.
mcq.expl:
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-infinitive or that-clause.
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: promise + to-V (hoặc that-clause).
mcq.key: He promised ___ on time.|to arrive

mcq.question: He promised that he ___ be late.
mcq.full: He promised that he wouldn’t be late.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy hứa rằng (anh ấy) sẽ không đến muộn.
mcq.expl:
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-infinitive or that-clause.
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: promise + that-clause.
mcq.key: He promised that he ___ be late.|wouldn’t

mcq.question: ‘I imagine I’ll see Olivia at the party.’ → He expected ___ Olivia at the party.
mcq.full: ‘I imagine I’ll see Olivia at the party.’ → He expected to see Olivia at the party.
mcq.vi: ‘Tôi nghĩ sẽ gặp Olivia ở bữa tiệc.’ → Anh ấy nghĩ sẽ gặp Olivia ở bữa tiệc.
mcq.expl:
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-infinitive or that-clause.
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: expect + to-V.
mcq.key: ‘I imagine I’ll see Olivia at the party.’ → He expected ___ Olivia at the party.|to see

mcq.question: She guaranteed ___ waiting times for operations.
mcq.full: She guaranteed to reduce waiting times for operations.
mcq.vi: Bà cam kết giảm thời gian chờ phẫu thuật.
mcq.expl:
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-infinitive or that-clause.
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: guarantee + to-V.
mcq.key: She guaranteed ___ waiting times for operations.|to reduce

mcq.question: The UN Secretary General has agreed ___ the leaders of both countries.
mcq.full: The UN Secretary General has agreed to meet the leaders of both countries.
mcq.vi: Tổng thư ký Liên Hợp Quốc đã đồng ý gặp lãnh đạo hai nước.
mcq.expl:
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-infinitive or that-clause.
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: agree + to-V.
mcq.key: The UN Secretary General has agreed ___ the leaders of both countries.|to meet

mcq.question: The President has said that he hoped ___ the Narian president would act now to prevent war.
mcq.full: The President has said that he hoped that the Narian president would act now to prevent war.
mcq.vi: Tổng thống nói ông hy vọng rằng tổng thống Naria sẽ hành động ngay để ngăn chiến tranh.
mcq.expl:
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-infinitive or that-clause.
promise / agree / expect / hope / propose / request / vow + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: hope + that-clause.
mcq.key: The President has said that he hoped ___ the Narian president would act now to prevent war.|that

mcq.question: There were cheers when he suggested that we ___ home early.
mcq.full: There were cheers when he suggested that we went home early.
mcq.vi: Mọi người reo hò khi anh ấy gợi ý chúng tôi về sớm.
mcq.expl:
insist / say / suggest + that-clause only; advise / order + object + to-infinitive or that-clause (not advise + to-infinitive).
insist / say / suggest + chỉ mệnh đề that; advise / order + tân ngữ + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that (không dùng advise + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: suggest + that-clause (không dùng suggest to go).
mcq.key: There were cheers when he suggested that we ___ home early.|went

mcq.question: I advised that she ___ accept.
mcq.full: I advised that she should accept.
mcq.vi: Tôi khuyên cô ấy nên nhận lời.
mcq.expl:
insist / say / suggest + that-clause only; advise / order + object + to-infinitive or that-clause (not advise + to-infinitive).
insist / say / suggest + chỉ mệnh đề that; advise / order + tân ngữ + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that (không dùng advise + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: advise + that-clause (không nói advised to accept).
mcq.key: I advised that she ___ accept.|should

mcq.question: In a major speech today, the Health Minister ___ to improve the country’s health care.
mcq.full: In a major speech today, the Health Minister promised to improve the country’s health care.
mcq.vi: Trong bài phát biểu quan trọng hôm nay, Bộ trưởng Y tế hứa cải thiện chăm sóc y tế.
mcq.expl:
insist / say / suggest + that-clause only; advise / order + object + to-infinitive or that-clause (not advise + to-infinitive).
insist / say / suggest + chỉ mệnh đề that; advise / order + tân ngữ + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that (không dùng advise + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: promise + to-V (suggest không đi với to-V).
mcq.key: In a major speech today, the Health Minister ___ to improve the country’s health care.|promised

mcq.question: She ___ that this could be done without raising taxes.
mcq.full: She said that this could be done without raising taxes.
mcq.vi: Bà nói điều này có thể thực hiện mà không tăng thuế.
mcq.expl:
insist / say / suggest + that-clause only; advise / order + object + to-infinitive or that-clause (not advise + to-infinitive).
insist / say / suggest + chỉ mệnh đề that; advise / order + tân ngữ + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that (không dùng advise + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: say + that-clause (intend không đi với that).
mcq.key: She ___ that this could be done without raising taxes.|said

mcq.question: The President of Guwandi has ___ Narian troops to withdraw from the border area.
mcq.full: The President of Guwandi has ordered Narian troops to withdraw from the border area.
mcq.vi: Tổng thống Guwandi đã ra lệnh quân đội Naria rút khỏi vùng biên giới.
mcq.expl:
insist / say / suggest + that-clause only; advise / order + object + to-infinitive or that-clause (not advise + to-infinitive).
insist / say / suggest + chỉ mệnh đề that; advise / order + tân ngữ + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that (không dùng advise + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: order + O + to-V (demand không đi với O + to-V).
mcq.key: The President of Guwandi has ___ Narian troops to withdraw from the border area.|ordered

mcq.question: The UN Secretary General has ___ that a peace conference should be held in New York early next week.
mcq.full: The UN Secretary General has proposed that a peace conference should be held in New York early next week.
mcq.vi: Tổng thư ký Liên Hợp Quốc đã đề xuất tổ chức hội nghị hòa bình ở New York đầu tuần tới.
mcq.expl:
insist / say / suggest + that-clause only; advise / order + object + to-infinitive or that-clause (not advise + to-infinitive).
insist / say / suggest + chỉ mệnh đề that; advise / order + tân ngữ + to-V hoặc mệnh đề that (không dùng advise + to-V).
Điểm ngữ pháp: propose + that-clause (offer không đi với that).
mcq.key: The UN Secretary General has ___ that a peace conference should be held in New York early next week.|proposed

mcq.question: Carolyn intends ___ to Dublin after a year in Canada.
mcq.full: Carolyn intends to return to Dublin after a year in Canada.
mcq.vi: Carolyn định trở về Dublin sau một năm ở Canada.
mcq.expl:
intend / long / offer / refuse / volunteer / want + to-infinitive only (not that-clause).
intend / long / offer / refuse / volunteer / want + chỉ to-V (không dùng mệnh đề that).
Điểm ngữ pháp: intend + to-V (không dùng that-clause).
mcq.key: Carolyn intends ___ to Dublin after a year in Canada.|to return

mcq.question: She said that she ___ to see significant improvements within a year.
mcq.full: She said that she expected to see significant improvements within a year.
mcq.vi: Bà nói bà mong đợi thấy cải thiện đáng kể trong vòng một năm.
mcq.expl:
intend / long / offer / refuse / volunteer / want + to-infinitive only (not that-clause).
intend / long / offer / refuse / volunteer / want + chỉ to-V (không dùng mệnh đề that).
Điểm ngữ pháp: expect + to-V (insist không đi với to-V).
mcq.key: She said that she ___ to see significant improvements within a year.|expected

mcq.question: ‘If I leave early, I’ll avoid the heavy traffic.’ → He hoped ___ the heavy traffic.
mcq.full: ‘If I leave early, I’ll avoid the heavy traffic.’ → He hoped to avoid the heavy traffic.
mcq.vi: ‘Nếu đi sớm, tôi sẽ tránh được tắc đường.’ → Anh ấy hy vọng tránh được tắc đường.
mcq.expl:
intend / long / offer / refuse / volunteer / want + to-infinitive only (not that-clause).
intend / long / offer / refuse / volunteer / want + chỉ to-V (không dùng mệnh đề that).
